note: Savings parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Two capabilities are graded: the single-period daily-balance interest rounding of the discriminating savings account (savings-daily-interest seam) and the m_savings_account.status_enum stored value a lifecycle command acknowledgement writes back (savings-account-status seam, approve -> 200 and activate -> 300). The monthly-posting account (SEED-Savings-Product) is captured but NOT in the graded domain: its two interest postings' day counts are derived from the MANIFEST prose rather than single transcribed capture fields, and neither posting is a discriminating rounding surface.

capabilities.name: daily-balance-interest-rounding
capabilities.description: The single-period daily-balance interest of the discriminating savings account SEED-Savings-Product-Daily (balance 1000.00 MNT at 0.1825%/yr, 365-day year, 1 day), whose raw daily interest 0.005 ties HALF_UP (0.01) against HALF_EVEN (0.00).
capabilities.evidence: Capture savings-account-daily-raw.json under tenant gerege: transaction id 5 (interest posting) wrote back amount 0.010000, the HALF_UP rounding of the MANIFEST's raw daily interest 0.005; the oracle posted 0.01.

capabilities.name: account-status-stored-value
capabilities.description: The m_savings_account.status_enum stored value Fineract writes into the acknowledgement of a lifecycle command on the discriminating savings account (id 2): approve -> 200 (savingsAccountStatusType.approved), activate -> 300 (savingsAccountStatusType.active). The stored value is NOT the Go declaration ordinal (APPROVED is 200, ACTIVE is 300, not 2/3), so a port encoding the enum as an iota silently corrupts status_enum.
capabilities.evidence: Captures savings-daily-approve-raw.json and savings-daily-activate-raw.json under tenant gerege: each command acknowledgement's changes.status field records the resulting status id (200 then 300) and code.

capabilities.name: monthly-posting
capabilities.description: The monthly-posting account SEED-Savings-Product (product id 1) with interest postings 0.15 (30 days) and 0.16 (31 days). The day counts are derived from the MANIFEST prose, not single transcribed capture fields, and neither posting ties HALF_UP against HALF_EVEN.
capabilities.evidence: Capture savings-account-monthly-raw.json under tenant gerege: transactions id 2 (0.16) and id 3 (0.15), but no single field records the 30-day/31-day day counts, so promotion does not port them.

seams.name: savings-daily-interest
seams.description: The daily-posting account read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the single-period daily-balance interest, the discriminating rounding surface.

seams.name: savings-account-status
seams.description: The lifecycle command acknowledgements on the same account, tenant gerege: changes.status.id in the approve ack (200) and the activate ack (300), the m_savings_account.status_enum stored values the oracle wrote for each observed step.
